senses.gloss:
द्रेक r. 1st cl. (ऋ) द्रेकृ (द्रेकते) 1. To sound.
 2. To grow or increase.
 3.
To manifest joy or elevation by noise. भ्वा० आ० अक० सेट् ।
द्रेक्क m. (-क्कः) The regent of one-third of a planetary sign.

द्रेक्काण m. (-णः) The regent of one-third of a planetary sign, the
Decanus of European astrology, whence the word is probably
derived.
